description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different configurations of SepLLM and a Vanilla model. The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents Loss Ratio (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot includes five lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, star marker, solid line), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, dash marker, solid line), SepLLM (n=128) (blue, square marker, solid line), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, triangle marker, solid line), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, circle marker, solid line). The Vanilla line remains steady at 100% across the x-axis, while the other lines exhibit varying trends: SepLLM (n=64) increases from approximately 98.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 100.1% at 3e8 TFLOPs before decreasing to about 99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs; SepLLM (n=128) starts at around 97% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to nearly 100% at 3e8 TFLOPs, and then declines to approximately 99% at 9e8 TFLOPs; SepLLM (n=64, H) begins at about 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs, reaches 100% at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then fluctuates around 100% before ending at around 99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs; SepLLM (n=64, H/T) starts at approximately 94% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to around 98.5% at 3e8 TFLOPs, and then decreases to about 98.5% at 9e8 TFLOPs, with some fluctuations in between.
